Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman discusses the upcoming Union Budget, the Tata Group dispute, foreign investment, jobs and Congress at the Financial Express Leadership Awards.
Will the Budget roll out a “red carpet for the dollar”? In this fireside chat, Sitharaman responds to concerns over foreign institutional investor (FII) outflows.
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
